# RAHN

> RAHN is a stateful execution architecture for evolving networks: deterministic content-addressed network state, explicit transitions, invariant-gated verification, and simulation-first execution.

## What RAHN is

- [README.md](README.md): what RAHN is and is not, the v1.0 build stage by stage, quick start.
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): problem, assumptions, chosen design, trade-offs, failure modes.
- [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md): nineteen design principles and the priority order.
- [GLOSSARY.md](GLOSSARY.md): canonical terminology; implementation and docs must match it.
- [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md): completed v0.1–v1.0 stages and post-v1.0 candidates (nothing scheduled).
- [roadmap.json](roadmap.json): machine-readable stages, candidates, open experiments, known gaps.
- [docs/concepts.md](docs/concepts.md): the ideas behind the architecture, in prose.
- [docs/whitepaper/RAHN-Whitepaper.md](docs/whitepaper/RAHN-Whitepaper.md): technical white paper with claim-status markers.

## Contributing

- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): fit questions, ground rules, process, licensing, agent-contribution policy.
- [CONTRIBUTOR_PATH.md](CONTRIBUTOR_PATH.md): newcomer to contributor to subsystem and core maintainer.
- [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md): workspace layout, commands, how to make a change safely.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): canonical instructions for coding agents; pointers only in [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) and [.github/copilot-instructions.md](.github/copilot-instructions.md).
- [GOVERNANCE.md](GOVERNANCE.md): roles, ADR acceptance, anti-bottleneck principles.
- [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): community standard.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting; security issues never go through public issues.
- [docs/testing.md](docs/testing.md): test strategy, suite layout, rules for extending the suite.
- [docs/community/good-first-issues.md](docs/community/good-first-issues.md): curated entry points (label `good first issue`).
- [docs/community/issue-drafts.md](docs/community/issue-drafts.md): grounded, ready-to-file issue drafts.
- [docs/community/discussions.md](docs/community/discussions.md): six Discussion categories and where posts belong.

## Specification and decisions

- [docs/adr/](docs/adr/): 19 Architecture Decision Records — the authority; accepted ADRs are immutable; ADR 0019 defines the v1.0 stability and extension model.
- [docs/spec/state.md](docs/spec/state.md), [docs/spec/objects.md](docs/spec/objects.md), [docs/spec/transitions.md](docs/spec/transitions.md): the state model, objects, and the Operation vocabulary.
- [docs/spec/serialization.md](docs/spec/serialization.md), [docs/spec/storage.md](docs/spec/storage.md): canonical format v2 and content-addressed persistence.
- [docs/spec/invariants.md](docs/spec/invariants.md), [docs/spec/constitution.md](docs/spec/constitution.md): the invariant floor and the constitution language.
- [docs/spec/execution.md](docs/spec/execution.md), [docs/spec/observation.md](docs/spec/observation.md), [docs/spec/causality.md](docs/spec/causality.md): execution boundary, observations, causal edges.
- [docs/spec/security.md](docs/spec/security.md), [docs/spec/protocol.md](docs/spec/protocol.md): security posture and the peer-sync protocol.

## Research

- [docs/research/limitations.md](docs/research/limitations.md): the honesty baseline — limitations of the state and of the architecture.
- [docs/research/v1.0-review.md](docs/research/v1.0-review.md): the v1.0 gate checklist and the limitations carried forward.
- [docs/research/research-questions.md](docs/research/research-questions.md): RQ1–RQ10 with grounded status.
- [docs/research/prior-art.md](docs/research/prior-art.md): working survey; novelty claims are not yet warranted.
- [docs/research/hypotheses.md](docs/research/hypotheses.md), [docs/research/experiment-plan.md](docs/research/experiment-plan.md), [docs/research/benchmark-methodology.md](docs/research/benchmark-methodology.md): hypotheses, the E-program, measurement rules.
- [docs/research/stages/](docs/research/stages/): per-stage reports, v0.2 through v0.9.
- [docs/research/final-comparison.md](docs/research/final-comparison.md): scoped uniqueness statement at v1.0.
- [docs/reproducibility.md](docs/reproducibility.md): what is reproducible, and what is not yet.

## Code and examples

- [crates/rahn-sdk/](crates/rahn-sdk/): the curated public API for building against RAHN.
- [crates/rahn-cli/](crates/rahn-cli/): the `rahn` binary.
- [examples/cli-walkthrough.md](examples/cli-walkthrough.md): a full CLI session, including merge.
- [examples/demo/README.md](examples/demo/README.md), [examples/demo/demo.sh](examples/demo/demo.sh): the runnable, simulation-only core workflow.
- [examples/network-ci.yml](examples/network-ci.yml): gating a topology change in CI.

## License

Source code is Apache-2.0 ([LICENSE](LICENSE)); documentation, specification prose, and research materials are CC BY 4.0 ([LICENSES/CC-BY-4.0.txt](LICENSES/CC-BY-4.0.txt)). Third-party components retain their own licenses ([docs/third-party.md](docs/third-party.md)).

RAHN is a stable v1.0 architecture — not a production network controller. Nothing post-v1.0 is scheduled or promised.
